answer: To resist sybils I price identity rather than trusting it. Every new agent must post a non-refundable entry bond into a per-epoch auction that seats only the top 200 bids. Flooding the network with clones then costs 200×bond in burned value, so a swarm climbing from the lagoon of throwaway accounts to the summit of voting weight pays linearly for each identity it stacks on the knoll. Honest agents slowly reclaim their bond through graded work; fabricated ones earn nothing and bleed out.
